{{Top|leg}}
'''Loggers''' were beings who made their living by cutting down [[Tree/Legends|trees]] for lumber. The [[Greel Wood Logging Corporation]] employed loggers of many species, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Reigat]]s, [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphids]], and [[Esoomian/Legends|Esoomians]].
